status: Exploratory and post hoc: the experiment with modified Conv1D and Conv2D encoders of Section 6.1 of the manuscript. Its changes and the rule that admits a modified model to the comparison were fixed in an amendment to the analysis plan dated 7 October 2026, after the results of the main experiment were known and before the runs that chose the changes. Earlier runs, which read no attack label and are described in Section 35 of the supplement, had trained the encoders with some of the changes. Its two comparisons with the KitNET-style control form a family of their own, outside the twelve confirmatory comparisons.

declaraciones: The list of changes and its order were designed with all detection results of the pre-specified analysis known, and two of the changes (R and I) bring the architecture closer to a per-record model.

Each modified autoencoder is fitted on the first 90% of the rows it receives (the last 10% is held out to check convergence), and its min-max normalisation comes from those rows only, so the clipping range used at scoring time comes from fewer rows than in the Conv1D models without the changes. No comparison here separates the changes P, I and R from this difference. The control does not clip its input at scoring time.

As in the pre-specified analysis, the benign segment on which these models and the control are fitted was delimited with the documentation and the attack labels of each corpus and checked with those labels to contain no attack, so this step of the pipeline is not free of labels.

The changes P, I and R were chosen on 3 of the 9 streams (the pre-flight streams), without attack labels; the same difference without those 3 streams is reported separately, as a descriptive result without a test.

The entry criterion of the modified Conv1D models, applied with seed A only and without labels, requires a validation ratio below 0.90 in at least two thirds of the evaluable TSR autoencoders and at least 7 of the 9 streams with at least one autoencoder below 0.90. With seed A, 21 of 29 evaluable TSR autoencoders had a validation ratio below 0.90, in 8 of the 9 streams. With seed B, 19 of 29 evaluable TSR autoencoders had a validation ratio below 0.90, in 9 of the 9 streams, which does not meet the criterion. A third seed (C) was added post hoc, after the count of the modified Conv1D models with seed B was known; its count with the same rule is given in the convergence table, and it does not enter this comparison.

declaraciones: The list of changes and its order were designed with all detection results of the pre-specified analysis known, and two of the changes (R and I) bring the architecture closer to a per-record model.

Each modified autoencoder is fitted on the first 90% of the rows it receives (the last 10% is held out to check convergence), and its min-max normalisation comes from those rows only, so the clipping range used at scoring time comes from fewer rows than in the Conv2D models without the changes. No comparison here separates the changes P, I, R and A from this difference. The control does not clip its input at scoring time.

As in the pre-specified analysis, the benign segment on which these models and the control are fitted was delimited with the documentation and the attack labels of each corpus and checked with those labels to contain no attack, so this step of the pipeline is not free of labels.

The changes P, I, R and A were chosen on 3 of the 9 streams (the pre-flight streams), without attack labels; the same difference without those 3 streams is reported separately, as a descriptive result without a test.

The entry criterion of the modified Conv2D models, applied with seed A only and without labels, requires a validation ratio below 0.90 in at least two thirds of the evaluable TSR autoencoders and at least 7 of the 9 streams with at least one autoencoder below 0.90. With seed A, 29 of 29 evaluable TSR autoencoders had a validation ratio below 0.90, in 9 of the 9 streams. With seed B, 28 of 29 evaluable TSR autoencoders had a validation ratio below 0.90, in 9 of the 9 streams. A third seed (C) was added post hoc, after the count of the modified Conv1D models with seed B was known; its count with the same rule is given in the convergence table, and it does not enter this comparison.
